name: target-kind-per-language-go-library
description: A target kind written per language names the Go code a library and the TypeScript code an application, so the Go analysis applies the library's rules: the package nothing imports is published API, whose findings the default minimum confidence withholds, and it carries no published-package note. An analyzer that reads the TypeScript member, or that treats the target as an application because one language is, reports them.
